inputs.prompt: The image is a vertical flat screenshot of a weather app on a phone, filling the whole frame edge to edge with no phone body visible, built from a smooth deep blue to pale blue vertical gradient background. At the very top of the frame a thin status bar shows "9:41" in small white text on the left. Below it, centred, the city name "LISBON" is set in medium white capitals, and beneath it a very large thin white numeral reads "18°", with the words "Partly Cloudy" in small white text under the numeral. Across the middle of the frame a translucent rounded white card holds a horizontal row of five columns, each with a time above a small weather icon above a temperature, reading "Now" "18°", "14:00" "19°", "15:00" "19°", "16:00" "17°" and "17:00" "16°". Below that card a second translucent rounded card lists five rows, one per day, each with the day on the left, a small icon in the middle and a temperature range on the right, reading "Mon 14° 19°", "Tue 13° 18°", "Wed 15° 21°", "Thu 16° 22°" and "Fri 12° 17°". In the lower part of the frame two small square tiles sit side by side, the left one labelled "UV INDEX" above a large "4", the right one labelled "WIND" above "12 km/h". The lighting is flat screen light with no shadows beyond the soft drop shadows under the cards. The overall composition is a clean vertical mobile interface layout, the palette built from deep blue, pale blue and white, and the mood is clear and modern.
